GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 2 Lengths clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths clear, same 100m, kept on well late, did enough # led/kicked/too good
Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off 3 Wide No Cover , improved Wide turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed approaching 200m and gave ground to the line # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up half off, same 100m, kept on strong late # had chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 50m was bumped and as a result lost ground. Promoted to 2nd on protest.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worke home well but never a threat # back/home ok
Jumped Ok sat 3l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, took over 200m and drew clear late # all honours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped. Near the 400m shifted in slightly and made contact with another runner. Shifted ground on a number of occasions whilst under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Stayed same until Two Wide @ 600m. Held up 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pushed to quicken Four Wide @ 400m & pressured Two Wide @ 300m. Challenged leaders @ 200m & outgunned Four Wide in last 100m. winkers off first time/visors first time. # Sound effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the early stages. Passing the 400m was momentarily awkwardly placed on heels. Laid out under pressure over the final 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field very Wide oiut 5 lengths. Wide turn under pressure. weakened # very Wide trip

Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 2nd 2 Lengths 1000m 2nd 2 Lengths home turn 2nd Under Pressure Straightened Up 4th Checked Kept Going Ok Stewards inquiry interference on straightening no rider found to be careless # on pace/ok effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On straightening had to be restrained when shifting out and being awkward on the hindquarters of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3-4l off 3 Wide No Cover , pushed along turn, Straightened Up 3l off, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast led early out Wide Eased back Settled Down 3 Wide No Cover Off Mid-Field 5l home turn 5l 200 laid in despite efforts of rider bumped gets to 2nd @ 100 run grabbed late R-riders of runners drawn Inside showed intent to go fwd, elected to Eased back to avoid being Caught wide, but was cgt 3 Wide for rest of race. Tr-not intention to lead last start when began much better than anticipated. # wide/effort told
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near 200m laid in. When qstd, rdr advised there was some variation in the instructions issued between owner and tnr. The instructions from tnr were from a wide gate were left to how the horse began. After beginning well, rdr advised when the rnrs drawn inside showed intent to go fwd, to avoid being trapped wide or having to make too much use to press fwd, he elected to ease back however was caught three-wide for the remainder. Tnr confirmed instructions and added that last start it was not the intention to lead, however began much better than anticipated on that occasion.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well equal lead rail, pushed along turn, headed Straightening Up , kept on ok b4 run ended approaching 100m and weakened sharply late # weak final 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: The mare which was in the adjoining barrier to the fractious horse underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed suitable to race.
